newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde April 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde April 11.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Senior aide to late president Francois Mitterrand hints members of former socialist governments took part in alleged telephone bugging from the Elysee presidential palace.
-- France Telecom to unveil prices set for competitors to lease its telephone lines as part of a telecommunications deregulation.
-- Industry minister Franck Borotra says in an interview he favours the idea of bringing Framatome and Alcatel Alsthom closer, calls for a quick privatisation of Framatome.
-- Two-thirds of Vilvoorde Renault plant's workers vote to resume work on Monday after a six-week strike.
-- Auchan retail group seeks to improve the profitability of Mammouth supermarkets.
-- Bank of France leaves rates unchanged.
-- Unions at TAT and Air Liberte to extend strike indefinitely.
